description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Brawl and Weapons checks.

Part of an Action: when your Action already uses Brawl and Weapons, one ally who helps you gains +1 on the same check.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
